{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows and column names
df_head = sales_df.head()
columns = sales_df.columns.tolist()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes

# Summary of the dataframe
summary = sales_df.describe(include='all')

# Print results
df_head, columns, missing_values, dtypes, summary"}
